title: Declare `KB_FORMAT` and the new workspace-runtime ids as the literals they hold
summary: `@inventarch/kb` declares `KB_FORMAT` as `"ia.kb.package.v1"`, exactly as 3.8.1 did, so code typed against that literal keeps compiling. `@inventarch/workspace-runtime` declares the ids it exports publicly for the first time, `CORPUS_INSPECT_HANDLER`, `CANDIDATE_VALIDATE_HANDLER`, `DRAFT_PUBLISH_HANDLER`, `CLAUDE_PROSE_PROFILE` and `CODEX_PROSE_PROFILE`, as the literals they hold, such as `"ia.host.claude-prose.v1"`, rather than `string`. Before release, the plain format names change had widened all six declarations to `string`. No value changes.
